title: Mother's family and the Bigard cousins
summary: Albert gives his mother's maiden name, and explains the McKenna family sisters and how he and Bonnie Bigard are cousins. Emil and Alec are sorted out.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
